validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/STATUS/LENGTH/CAPACITY/LOCATION all strongly corroborated, independent of GEM and of each other: primeminister.kz (official PM press release, 2023-10-23), dknews.kz (already cited on the sheet elsewhere; 2023-06-26, quoting QazaqGaz deputy chairman Meirbek Ikhsanov), neftegaz.ru (Russian trade press, 2023-10-24), tengrinews.kz (2023-11-27, quoting Mangystau akim Nurlan Nogayev at a press conference), and the official Kazakh government resolution adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2100000784 ('Комплексный план социально-экономического развития Мангистауской области на 2021-2025 годы', item 118: 'Строительство 2-й нитки магистрального газопровода "Бейнеу-Жанаозен" (308 км...)'). All agree: second line ('вторая нитка'/'2 нитка'), 308 km, launched carrying gas 2023-10-23 by PM Alikhan Smailov via telebridge, capacity 5.8 bcm/y, classified 'магистральный газопровод' (main/trunk transmission pipeline, matching GEM's PipelineType=transmission), entirely within Beyneuskiy/Mangystauskiy/Karakiyanskiy districts of Mangystau Oblast (per the ecoportal.kz environmental-assessment PDF, ecoportal.kz/Public/PubHearings/LoadFile/185033, whose route description places the 2nd line's crossing 1.855 km from Zhanaozen city and 1.147 km from Beyneu settlement -- note this PDF FAILS url_verifier's automated substring check on a big/scanned-layout doc, a documented false-negative; I confirmed the text manually via `pdftotext -layout` and it contains the exact passages quoted). Status=operating, Fuel=Gas, StartYear1=2023/StartMonth1=10 are therefore CONFIRMED at tier=high (the automated existing_ref_check 'value not found' flag on Status is a literal-token miss only -- the article describes the PM personally starting gas flow through the line, which confirms operating status by context per url_verifier's own documented STATUS-is-inferable rule). SegmentCost=180,000,000,000 KZT is likewise confirmed by 2 independent sources (primeminister.kz: 'инвестировано порядка 180 млрд тенге'; dknews.kz: '...в размере 180 млрд тенге'). 

THE ONE GENUINE DEFECT: ConstructionYear=2021 (currently MISSING_REF, i.e. someone entered the value with no citation). dknews.kz -- already cited by the sheet's own gem.wiki page for other facts -- directly and specifically states: 'В феврале 2023 года национальная компания QazaqGaz начала строительство второй нитки магистрального газопровода "Бейнеу-Жанаозен"' (In February 2023, national company QazaqGaz began construction of the second line of the Beyneu-Zhanaozen trunk gas pipeline), attributed on the record to QazaqGaz deputy chairman Meirbek Ikhsanov, and gives a matching progress narrative (30% complete by June 2023, planned completion Q4 2023, matching the actual Oct 2023 launch). The government plan document's own budget-line dates for this same project item (Q4-2022 target, revised to Q4-2023) are also consistent with a 2022-2023 build window, not 2021. The most likely origin of the sheet's '2021' is conflating the *regional development plan's* window ('...на 2021-2025 годы', which the project sits inside) with the pipe's actual construction-start year -- a plan-approval-year vs. construction-start-year mixup. This is a single strong company-official on-record source (tier=medium under the near-2-independent standard for a bespoke fact, though it is corroborated circumstantially by the government plan's budget timeline), but it is unambiguous and it directly contradicts the sheet, so it is flagged as a concern rather than silently left alone.

SECONDARY CAVEAT (not itself flagged wrong, just unconfirmable): Diameter=1000mm's sole citation, ppt-online.org/671158, is now walled behind a client-side proof-of-work/CAPTCHA anti-bot challenge (a JS SHA-256 nonce puzzle) -- a live page, not a 404/410, so per standing rule it must NOT be treated as a dead link or removed. I could not reach its content and could not find the 1000mm figure independently anywhere in the open web (multiple targeted RU-language searches on the 2nd line's technical specs came back empty on diameter -- length and capacity are reported everywhere, diameter nowhere). A same-corridor GulfPub trace ('Beyneu-Tenge', ~318.65 km, 40in/~1016mm) matched instead to the older P2492 (Okarem-Beyneu) row, not to P5772, so it doesn't help pin this row's diameter either. I attempted a Wayback Machine check on ppt-online.org/671158 but archive.org rate-limited me (429) before I could confirm a snapshot exists; worth a follow-up. Leaving Diameter/ref as-is (no change), just flagging the access state honestly rather than silently re-verifying it as OK.

DUPLICATE CHECK: not a duplicate. P5772 is a genuinely distinct, newer (2023) *second, parallel* line built alongside the pre-existing single line on the same Beyneu-Zhanaozen corridor (which itself is functionally a southward extension of the Okarem-Beyneu/CAC system, per dknews.kz: 'газопровод "Окарем-Бейнеу" по этому маршруту обеспечивал прокачку чуть более 3 млрд куб. метров' -- i.e. the OLD single line along this same route already went by the 'Okarem-Beyneu' family name, which is why GEM's pipeline_name='Okarem-Beyneu Gas Pipeline' / segment_name='Beyneu-Zhanaozen Gas Pipeline II' framing is defensible, not a mislabeling). This is the same modeling pattern as the roster's other genuinely-parallel-string pairs (P2289/P5695 Bukhara-Ural, P0739/P5810 BGR-TBA). No overlap with the Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau family (P3948/P5776/P5777/P5783/P5784) either -- that family moves gas FROM Zhanaozen/Uzen SOUTH to Zhetybay/Aktau/Kuryk for coastal distribution, a different leg entirely from this Beyneu(north)->Zhanaozen(south) import spur. OSM has no matching trace for this row (route_accuracy correctly 'very low/schematic').

validity.recommendation: Re-examine FuelSource='Zhanaozen'. Per gem_schema.md, FuelSource should name the upstream field/plant/facility that FEEDS gas into the line, not an endpoint label. Every independent source describes this pipeline's purpose as delivering CAC/transit gas via Beyneu (north/upstream, where the pipe ties into the wider Central Asia-Center system) SOUTH INTO Zhanaozen/Mangystau Oblast for local consumption (population, MAEK power plant, industry) -- i.e. Zhanaozen is the delivery/downstream end, not a supplying gas field. I found no source naming an actual 'Zhanaozen' gas field or plant as this line's upstream source. This looks like the same defect class as the Saudi FuelSource fills that had to be dropped for defaulting to the wrong kind of value (here, an endpoint name standing in for a true upstream facility) rather than a researched attribution. Recommend either blanking FuelSource pending a real upstream-facility identification, or confirming with QazaqGaz/Intergas Central Asia documentation what specifically feeds this line (most plausibly the Beyneu compressor station / CAC transit supply, not a Zhanaozen-area field).
validity.researcher_notes: No independent source names a 'Zhanaozen' gas field or plant as feeding this pipeline. All sources consistently describe gas flowing FROM the Beyneu/CAC-transit side TO the Zhanaozen/Mangystau consumption side, the opposite direction from what 'FuelSource=Zhanaozen' would imply if read as an upstream supply origin. Not confident enough to propose a replacement value (would risk fabricating an attribution), so flagging for Update rather than filling.

Two independent RU-language sources (PM press office; DKNews trade coverage quoting QazaqGaz's own deputy chairman) both give ~180 billion tenge for this project, matching the sheet's value exactly.

Both the PM press release and DKNews attribute the project's financing and asset ownership to QazaqGaz (own funds, plus Samruk-Kazyna and Ministry of Energy support -- QazaqGaz's own quoted deputy chairman speaks of it as the company's project).

inaktau.kz names AO Intergas Central Asia (via its UMG Aktau branch) as the entity that operates/maintains the 'Beyneu-Zhanaozen' pipeline system generally (discussing the 13.38 km 1st-line branch repair). Only one direct source found naming ICA specifically for THIS named pipeline (as opposed to the wider ICA pipeline roster on intergas.kz, which lists many other named lines but does not itself enumerate Beyneu-Zhanaozen), so tier=medium rather than high -- flagging honestly rather than padding with a second source that doesn't actually corroborate. Consistent with QazaqGaz being the financing/owning parent and Intergas Central Asia being its operating subsidiary for the main-pipeline network, the same pattern as the sheet's other Okarem-Beyneu-family rows.

summary: P5772 (Beyneu-Zhanaozen Gas Pipeline II) is REAL and correctly classified/located -- existence, status=operating, Fuel, PipelineType=transmission, length 308 km, capacity 5.8 bcm/y, StartYear 2023-10, and SegmentCost 180bn KZT are all confirmed at tier=high across 5 independent RU-language sources (PM press office, DKNews, Neftegaz.ru, Tengrinews, and an official Mangystau Oblast government resolution) plus corroborating environmental-assessment filings; not a duplicate of P2492 or the Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau family.
